doc.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024

chapter: The trombone and the business today
title: Musicians' union history and work on Broadway
summary: Rowe mentions pit musicians losing jobs to sound film; Davis says Broadway still employs musicians and every generation laments.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: Well you just gave some great advice.
Well thank you. I guess I’m old enough now that hopefully something comes out that makes sense.

Yeah. I was struck the other day I was reading some stuff on the Musicians’ Union and there was a historical footnote that in 1927 when the “soundies” started, when they figured out how to put sound on film, that thousands of pit musicians became unemployed. So some things never change.

That’s right, yeah. But you know there’s still a lot of work on Broadway for live musicians. So I know the sky was falling but that’s almost a hundred years ago now and it’s still going. And is it as healthy as it’s been? No. But it’s still a viable piece of the business, especially in New York in terms of freelancing as an instrumentalist. So you know I get why people especially of my generation and older are not thrilled about things because there’s a lot not to be thrilled about. But there’s also opportunities for young players and it’s not all gloom and doom. I remember somebody said to me one time, every generation says that. You know you get to New York and the older generation says, “Oh man, you should have been here back when,” you know and “you should have been here back then” and the older generation told them that. You know when was this period that everybody keeps referring to? You know it’s always like that so I mean you know I think you’ve got to be — I think you’ve got to be fired up and passionate and your work ethic has to be totally on point, but I believe it’s still very much a possibility to have success in the business.
